# Human TRB smoke-test sequences

`human-trb.tsv` contains three full-length human beta-chain TCR transcript
sequences from SRA accession SRR11341217. The sequences are a small subset of
the `extdata/TCR/SRR11341217.fasta.gz` example distributed with `igblastr`
1.0.23.

The source dataset was downloaded by the igblastr maintainers from
<https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sra/SRX7944361>.
